numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))

parityFlags = [num % 2 for num in numbers]
oddCount = sum(p for p in parityFlags)
evenCount = n - oddCount

# Special case check

    print(1)
    exit()

eCount = 0
oCount = 0
costArray = []

        eCount += 1
    else:
        oCount += 1
    if eCount == oCount:
        costArray.append(differences[i])

if costArray:
    costArray.sort()
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for c in costArray:
        prevSum = total
        total += c
        if total > B and prevSum <= B:
            print(count)
            exit()
        count += 1
    print(count)
else:
    print(0)
